text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Agnes Tachyon will be training in her signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Mmm… I'm generally not particular about clothing, but I like this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The fabric and design have no special characteristics besides to protect the body. However…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Neat Racewear
text_block_list.text: Wow! That design is super bold!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Flashy Racewear
text_block_list.text: Yours has a much calmer vibe. But it suits you. Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Neat Racewear
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'm glad I chose this design. …I gotta admit, signature racewear really is something special, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Flashy Racewear
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Wearing this gives me like a surge of motivation.. really makes me feel I've gotta give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that conversation just now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Each Umamusume has her own particular style when it comes to signature racewear. I believe there lies hidden potential in that choice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Do you know what it is?
choice_data_list: Something like the power of dreams?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, you understand well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Dreams… the power to believe. We shouldn't think it entirely unrelated to science.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's right… Simply put, it's something akin to conviction or motivation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Things like being number one, being in the lead, or never losing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It may very well be that contained within each signature racewear are these hopes and aspirations.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Of course, this power of dreams is a hypothetical concept that has yet to be proven.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Nevertheless, it seems apparent that Umamusume believe in that power, choosing to infuse their wishes into their racewear.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I suppose… I can't say if I believe it or not, but I have chosen to infuse something into mine as well.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, try and guess what it is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon is attempting to go beyond the limits of Umamusume—to tap into her true potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she's infused something in her signature racewear, it must be…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, you have an answer?
choice_data_list: Your dedication to the potential of Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right! You could say it captures my belief.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Regardless of what lies ahead, I'll continue my research and search for potential…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Until the day I attain the ultimate Umamusume body!
choice_data_list: I'll support you however I can!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Nice answer! Then, let's proceed with the experiment right away!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What this signature racewear holds for me…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Is my determination to see this experiment through!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'll advance my developments in body modification… and dash forward with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All right, let's start with turf! Be sure to keep time, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Exactly! It's wonderful that you understand so well!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Running, to me, is both the experiment and the mechanism through which I will reach that potential!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Of course, my running alone won't be enough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Each person's desires and wishes differ, and thus, so will what they gain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Those differences might be trivial in the end.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However! They cannot be overlooked!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: When it comes to experiments, the slightest differences can lead to potential breakthroughs! They can yield significant results!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All right, if you understand, then let's get ready to record some results right away!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Umamusume clad in one-of-a-kind racewear infused with their determination…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: We won't get a better chance to observe their running up close!
